name: Leaderboard for WooCommerce
author: WP-Tlon

sections.description:
An AJAX-powered plugin for WooCommerce that shows monthly customer leaderboards with medals and monthly prizes. Encourage competition, reward loyalty, and increase engagement on your store.

Introduction

Engage your customers and boost sales by turning shopping into a fun competition! Reward your top customers with visually appealing medals (gold, silver, bronze) and display their achievements prominently, fostering loyalty and driving repeat business.

Features

  • Dynamic Leaderboard Display: Show a real-time ranking of your customers based on configurable criteria.
  • Medal System: Automatically award gold, silver, and bronze medals to top-ranked customers.
  • Shortcode Support: Display the leaderboard anywhere on your site using a simple shortcode with many options.
  • User-Friendly Settings: Simple interface for configuring all plugin options. Light or dark plugin theme.
  • Prize Management: Set up and assign monthly prizes (products from your shop) for the top 3 positions directly from the plugin’s admin menu.
  • Monthly Purchase Calculation: Accurately calculate each user’s monthly purchase amount, considering only “completed” orders for fair ranking.
  • Detailed User Information: Administrators can view user details (full name, email, phone, and position) within the leaderboard interface. Logged-in users can view their own ranking and details.
  • Multilingual and ready for translations: Languages included: English, Ukrainian, German, French, Spanish.
  • Create CSV file with leaderboard (PRO version).
  • Send e-mails to winners (PRO version).

Documentation

https://kalinovski.com.ua/leaderboard/

About Alex Kalinovski

Professional web developer with 15 years of experience in creating robust and user-friendly web solutions, specializing in WordPress and WooCommerce.

PRO version

  1. Additional criteria for winners (by number of orders).
  2. Unlimited prizes for each place.
  3. Send emails to top 3 winners.
  4. CSV file with leaderboard generation.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Leaderboard to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
1. How do I assign monthly prizes?
    You can set prizes for 1-3 place (prize is a product from your shop) from the plugin’s admin menu (monthly prizes). Free version is limited to 1 prize for each place.

  2. How is the leaderboard ranking calculated?
    The plugin calculates the monthly purchase amount for each user. Only orders with the status “completed” are taken into account. Calculation is based on total monthly amount. With PRO version, you can change criteria and set it based on order quantity.
